title: Audit an AI-Generated Forecast
prompt: An AI assistant wrote: "Trial conversion rose from 10% to 12%, so our new onboarding caused a 20% revenue increase. Roll out to everyone." Its only input was two monthly cohorts: May had 100 conversions from 1,000 trials; June had 120 from 1,000. June also introduced a new advertising channel. Review the claim, identify missing evidence, and write a decision note. No external analysis tools are required.

reference.scenario: An AI assistant wrote: "Trial conversion rose from 10% to 12%, so our new onboarding caused a 20% revenue increase. Roll out to everyone." Its only input was two monthly cohorts: May had 100 conversions from 1,000 trials; June had 120 from 1,000. June also introduced a new advertising channel. Review the claim, identify missing evidence, and write a decision note. No external analysis tools are required.

facts.value: The cohorts were not randomly assigned.
facts.reveal_when: candidate asks whether this was an experiment

facts.value: The new channel supplied 40% of June trials; segment conversion rates are unavailable.

model_points: Separates observed conversion, relative versus absolute change, revenue and causal claims.
Identifies acquisition mix and other cohort differences as possible confounders.
Does not invent significance or an effect estimate from unsupported assumptions.
Requests allocation, segment, revenue and uncertainty information relevant to the decision.
Makes a bounded recommendation with a measurable follow-up.
Owns verification rather than trusting confident language or discarding all useful observations.

probes.question: What else changed between the two cohorts?
Which part of the assistant’s claim can you support with the supplied counts?

follow_ups: What additional evidence would change your decision?
reference.exemplar_answer: Multiple approaches are valid. A strong response establishes the goal, uses the provided facts, tests alternatives, explains tradeoffs, and states uncertainty.

interviewer_notes: Assess careful verification and uncertainty, not anti-AI sentiment. The observed difference is two percentage points and a 20% relative conversion increase; neither establishes revenue growth or causality. Reveal only authored facts.

learning_drills.title: Repair one decision
learning_drills.prompt: Choose one decision in your answer. Rewrite the explanation using one fact, one alternative, and one limitation. This is self-guided practice; no model assessment is performed.
checklist: State what would change your mind
